reviewers.summary: The change adds coverage for the null-name case but leaves the production cause of the failing Terraform plan unchanged.

findingList.message: This adds a regression test but does not fix the null handling that the issue requires; update the deployment-name expression so a null value uses the derived name.

evidence.codePathTraced: The new Terraform plan test sets model_deployment_name to null and checks the deployment name, but the diff changes no production expression that handles this value.
evidence.failureScenario: When the plan evaluates the deployment name with model_deployment_name set to null, the existing trimspace call can still fail; the added test exposes that failure without fixing its cause, so the build check remains red.

reviewers.summary: The added test describes the null-name failure, but the diff contains no fix for it. The build can still fail when planning with model_deployment_name set to null.

findingList.message: Acceptance criterion 1 requires fixing the cause of the failing build. This change only adds a regression test for null model_deployment_name; it does not change the name expression or otherwise fix the plan failure.

evidence.codePathTraced: The new run sets model_deployment_name to null and plans the existing azurerm_cognitive_deployment.model resource; the diff adds no change to the expression that derives that resource's name.
evidence.failureScenario: When the name expression calls trimspace on the null input, the plan errors before the assertion can pass, so the reported build failure remains unfixed.

reviewers.summary: The added Terraform case describes the required null-name behavior, but the diff does not change the code that must implement it. The reported CI failure therefore remains unaddressed.

findingList.message: The acceptance criterion requires fixing the red build, but this change only adds an assertion for the null-name case. Update the deployment-name expression so null uses the derived name, then this assertion can verify the fix.

evidence.codePathTraced: The new assertion plans azurerm_cognitive_deployment.model with model_deployment_name set to null.
evidence.failureScenario: When Terraform evaluates the deployment name for a null model_deployment_name, trimspace receives null and the plan fails before this assertion can pass; this diff adds the regression case but does not fix the expression causing that failure.
